contract: A parent calls two child workflows sequentially with distinct typed arguments. Each child executes a real activity and returns its committed echo with a child-workflow marker; the parent returns both committed results once and in declaration order. Preserve distinct call/link/child-instance/child-run and activity-attempt identities, original parent relationships, namespace/queue/type keys, authored sequences, original arguments and exact int64 results. Parent histories bind scheduling, start and terminal resolution to the original child run, and a second call begins only after the first resolves. HTTP child histories omit StartAccepted while embedded child histories record their start command; retain and check these explicit inventories before comparing common durable behavior. Default parent-close and cancellation policies are abandon; this fixture does not qualify child failure, retry, cancellation, parent-close effects or cross-language directions.
